needsReview.note: Backend gap: POST /prescriptions/upload stores the base64 on the prescription row and returns no scan_status, so the patient apps cannot show "being checked" for it and no 423 can happen; if the photo is moved to the scanned store it must answer scan_status.
Backend gap: POST /labs/bookings/:id/documents takes a data URL and returns no scan_status; the page navigates away at once, so no pending or rejected state is shown.
Backend gap: the badge cannot clear by itself; patient-web has no GET route for /storage/:id or /media/:id/url (only the voice route), so it stays "being checked" until the page is left.
Backend gap: no GET route in the web BFF to open the attachment, so the badge cannot retry and clear.
